effect_description_eng:
[On Play] [When Digivolving] 1 of your Digimon may attack without suspending. Then, for every 2 of your Digimon and Tamers' colors, activate 1 effect below:
・This Digimon may battle 1 of your opponent's Digimon.
・By returning 5 cards from your opponent's trash to the bottom of the deck, ＜Recovery +1＞ (Place the top card of your deck as your top security card.)
[All Turns] This Digimon gains all colors in its digivolution cards, and +1000 DP for each of your Digimon and Tamers' colors.
xros_req:
[Digivolve] [Omnimon]: Cost 2 
Assembly Requirements [Assembly -8] 6 [ADVENTURE] trait Digimon cards w/different colors
When this would be played, by placing the specified cards from the trash under it, reduce the play cost.
